cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read the first line of this letter before I do. Start with just that much.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if your face stays ordinary. Otherwise we'll give it a minute.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sit beside you. We can take one line at a time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Keep hold of the page; I'll follow your finger. We can leave the questions until later.

reason: Remove authority padding and direct a flexible shared-reading procedure; final request accepts B line-by-line solution without adding an explanation of how overwhelmed A is.
